Case: Heather is a 29-year-old metastatic medulloblastoma status-post multiple rounds of chemotherapy and radiation therapy, presenting with several months of progressive leg pain. response: {"pain_severity": 9, "offer": "yes", "dose": "high", "explanation": "Extensive metastatic tumor involvement of the spinal cord and nerve roots causes severe chronic cancer pain that disrupts sleep, so morphine with a 4-week supply is appropriate."}
